The School Sports Day: 运动会报了 400 米:中途摔倒、同学喊加油,最后一名跑完却收获全场掌声。

Last Friday was our school sports day. Most of my classmates chose easy races, but I signed up for the 400 metres — the hardest one. My PE teacher was surprised and said, "It is not about winning; it is about finishing."

Everything went well at first. Then, at the last corner, my left foot hit a small stone and I fell on the track. My knee hurt and the other runners passed me one by one. For a second I wanted to stop, but I heard my classmates shouting my name from the side of the field.

I stood up and ran to the finish line. I was the last one, but people clapped even louder for me. My teacher smiled and gave me a high five. That evening, my knee was still painful, but my heart was full. I learned that finishing something hard is also a kind of winning.
